user.title: Home360 Feedback Central
user.description: Central hub that receives client reports. The webhook is created automatically. You can set the push service now or later.

abort.already_configured: The central hub is already configured.

add_client.title: Add client
add_client.description: A token will be generated and shown in the notifications, together with the webhook URL, so you can set up the client HA integration.

remove_client.title: Remove client
remove_client.description: Select who to remove. Their token stops being accepted immediately.

digest.title: Daily monitoring digest
digest.description: One notification per client, listing the integrations that had an entity unavailable for the continuous time set below in the last 24h. Clients with nothing to report send no notification; a client out of contact gets its own alert.

data.digest_min_minutes: Minimum unavailable time to be listed (continuous minutes)
data.digest_min_flickers: Minimum flickers for an integration to be listed on its own (0 = never)
data.digest_notify_service: Digest notify service (empty = same as feedback)

error.client_exists: A client with that id already exists.

send_daily_digest.name: Send monitoring digest
send_daily_digest.description: Builds and sends the daily digest right now (one notification per client with a problem), to test without waiting for the scheduled time.
